title: Hearth community map
description: Metadata for one battle map image stored next to it in maps/. Hearth's personal map library (addMapToLibrary) stores { id, name, thumb, createdAt, origName } in localStorage and the image in IndexedDB; the importer fetches `image`, then runs it through the same path. The image file itself must be under 5 MB.

image.description: File name of the image in maps/, e.g. my-map.png

thumbnail.description: Optional small preview (about 220 px wide, under 200 KB) in maps/. If missing, the importer uses the full image.

gridSizePx.description: Pixel size of one 5-ft grid square, if the map has a grid
